name: Read Past Agent Session
description: Reads a bounded, model-safe transcript projection. An agent may omit agentId to inspect itself; an owner or authorised caller supplies agentId. Omit sessionId for the newest visible session. Compacted history is retained and can be opened to a bounded depth; a summary is marked compacted, with the turns it stands for. Set current to read back the session you are in: after a compaction, the turns your summary stands for, when you need their exact words. Page back with skip while older is true. Otherwise the caller's current session, missing sessions and sessions hidden by venue policy all return exactly {found:false}. Tool scratch, diagnostics and unanswered turns are omitted.

agentId.description: Optional target agent id or g/<id> path. Omit only from that agent's own execution context. Reading an explicit target requires agent read access.

sessionId.description: Optional 16-byte hex session id, with or without a 0x prefix. Omit to read the newest visible session.

maxChars.description: Maximum total content characters. A single oversized turn is truncated. Default 8000.

archiveDepth.description: Compacted archive levels to open before applying the safe bounded projection. Default 0 returns compacted summaries only.

skip.description: Newest projected messages to pass over, to page further back. Default 0.

current.description: Read the session you are in, from your own execution context: only what is no longer in your context, the turns behind its compaction summaries. Omit sessionId and agentId. Empty when the session was never compacted.

turnCount.description: Total turns in the safe projection, before response bounds.

older.description: Older messages remain before this page: read them with a larger skip.

current.description: True when this is the caller's own current session, read with current.
